dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, asymmetrical light-pixel clusters situated between the anterior flipper and the mid-body annuli. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the primary elongated mid-lateral annulus, the smaller circular dorsal-mid annulus, and the most prominent anterior-lateral blob form an acute scalene triangle, establishing a fixed geometric relationship across the mid-dorsal plane.
